messages:
Raj: heads up — seeing sustained reconciler lag and controller-manager leader churn in eu-central. lots of Pending pods in gpu-pool-2 since ~15:05UTC. anyone on it?
Anya: I see high etcd request latency around that time, p99 ~200ms -> 400ms for a short window. could be network/egress pressure. :eyes:
Mike: also seeing scheduler errors around 15:07:
```
W0715 15:07:12.345678 1 scheduler.go:123] FailedScheduling: pod/xyz: no nodes match GPU label
E0715 15:07:13.001234 1 bind.go:89] bind failed: context deadline exceeded
```
OpsBot: Alert: APISERVER_HIGH_LATENCY triggered at 15:12UTC — apiserver request latency p95=620ms, error rate increased (5xx spikes).
Lucy: checking NAT/gateway metrics — egress connections and ephemeral port usage spiked ~2x starting 15:03, lots of concurrent image pulls and helper jobs. NAT SNAT table nearing capacity.
Raj: we had a batch training job autoscale go live at 15:00 and it burst the GPU pool by ~40 nodes. could have amplified egress + etcd load. cost FYI: ~\$1.6k. :moneybag:
Anya: controller-manager logs show leader election flips: "lost leader lease"/"acquired leader" around same window. etcd raft RTT also jittery. suspect control-plane connectivity noise.
SRE-Oncall: I'll take lead. quick action plan: 1) pause cluster autoscaler for gpu-pool-2, 2) scale down the batch job to reduce egress, 3) cordon & drain 2 most impacted nodes to reprovision, 4) monitor etcd raft RTT and apiserver latencies. executing now.
Mike: quick debug note — disabling prefix cache won't help here, but reducing controller-manager concurrency may stop the churn while we stabilize.
OpsBot: Action: scaledown job batch/image-builder from 120 -> 10 replicas at 15:18UTC (triggered by SRE-Oncall).
Lucy: after scaledown p99 raft RTT dropped to ~35ms and apiserver p95 back to ~180ms within 4 mins. controller-manager still logging occasional 503 proxy errors to leader at 15:22.
Raj: confirmed most Pending pods that queued after 15:10 are now scheduling. good. tagging @platform-cost for the burst charge note.
Anya: follow-ups: add soft guardrails on autoscaler burst (max-burst-per-region), add NAT scaling/monitoring alerts, and leader-election metrics alerting for controller-manager. I'll file a ticket.
SRE-Oncall: created INC-4521 (https://internal.incidents/INC-4521) — owner Anya, will move to postmortem channel in 1h for writeup. closing this slack thread unless new regressions. :white_check_mark:
